# {Feature Name} Tech Plan

**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Version:** v1
**Status:** Draft

**Document References:**
- Decision-doc: `{/<cycle_id>/tech/diagnostic/decision-doc.md}`
- Product-doc: `{path}` / N/A

---

CTX.heading: Context
CTX.intent: Verified current state, problem, and situational facts needed to understand the change. Reusable patterns and reference implementations belong here when relevant to the change.
CTX.intent_boundary: Goal outcomes, scope commitments, architecture, phases, tasks, invariants, and acceptance/verification belong to GO, SC, AR, SK, T, I, VF.

GO.heading: Goal
GO.intent: One clear before→after outcome (checkable states). Observable acceptance criteria and AC mapping belong to VF.
GO.intent_boundary: Background, architecture detail, phases, and task steps belong to CTX, AR, SK, T. Touch surfaces belong to SC; checkable post-ship constraints belong to I. Acceptance criteria, layered behavioral verdicts, and verification commands belong to VF.

SC.heading: Scope
SC.intent: Surfaces, systems, repos, and boundaries this change touches; concrete paths when codebase read supports them; and items explicitly out of scope or deferred (Non-Goals). Surfaces not listed are out of touch for this change unless Scope is explicitly revised.
SC.intent_boundary: Checkable post-ship constraints belong to I; architecture, phased execution, and task breakdown belong to AR, SK, T. RACI and collaboration-protocol essays are not Scope substance.

AR.heading: Architecture
AR.intent: Structural approach: components, responsibilities, data or control flow, and module-level interface contracts when modules change; and the rationale for choosing this structural approach. Key flows stay at structural-sketch depth.
AR.intent_boundary: Phased execution, checkbox tasks, verification commands, file-level edits, and stepwise implementation recipes belong to SK, T, VF (recipes and per-file edits → T).

I.heading: Invariants
I.intent: Constraints that must always hold after ship; each independently checkable.
I.intent_boundary: Option trade-offs are out of scope for the plan; phased skeleton, tasks, and detailed verification belong to SK, T, VF.

SK.heading: Approach Skeleton
SK.intent: Phased execution skeleton: execution arc, stages with Done When, Depends On, Parallel, and reversibility.
SK.intent_boundary: Bite-sized checkbox steps and per-file edit lists belong to T; verify commands belong to VF.

T.heading: Tasks
T.intent: Actionable tasks traced to SK ids; code-facing tasks carry codebase-grounded paths (non-code must be explicit).
T.intent_boundary: Goal rewrites and architecture redesign belong to GO, AR.

VF.heading: Verification
VF.intent: How Goal, Scope, Invariants, and Tasks are verified; AC mapping with commands or concrete steps, including AC-to-task-id traceability when AC ids are defined (required when AC rows exist); and pre-implementation checklist rows for any assumptions still open at implementation time, each tagged Must Close Before the phase that depends on it (explicit none if empty). Goal section states Before→After only.
VF.intent_boundary: New scope, architecture, or task items belong to SC, AR, T.
